name: tracker-backup-overwrite
goal: A backup written by another database never replaces or rotates the hub's backups, and backup status checks the newest file on disk

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Repro: a second hub (other db, active host effects, same HOME) writes tracker-<date>.db.gz into the default ~/backups/tracker/native and renames over the live hub's file; live status keeps reporting last_ok from its state file. Writer proven: esqhv8 rig state file last_ok 2026-11-26T17:02:24.871Z size 3094. Expected: another db id never replaces or rotates backups; status checks the file on disk.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: tracker-backup.test.ts and trackerBackupFixture only ran one database per backup folder, and status was only read straight after a successful write, never after the file changed. Reusable change: fixture 'sharing' option for a second hub on the same folders; three scenarios in the standard backup test.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: loop record red at 191a9d60: bunx vitest run test/services/projects-sessions/tracker-backup.test.ts, 3 failed 6 passed; a foreign db replaced a same-day file (ok:true) and status had no file check.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: assertTrackerBackupOwner: newest daily and every file about to be replaced must carry this db id (unreadable fails closed), before rename. status.file_error checks last_ok_file presence and size; stale and health fail; one alert.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: loop record green at 28cc91a7: same unchanged command and files, 9/9 passed.

steps.title: Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Local on 28af4c5d (same product code and tests as green e653e9f8): every check stage passed except check:desktop unit tests, run twice at 1606 passed / 1 failed with a different failure each run (remote-replay poll timeout; game-image workerd DNS crash), each passing alone, packages/desktop untouched; desktop build, audit and ios:check:limits passed separately. build and test:package passed on e84af14eec, which differs only by one test comment. CI run 45976515403 on 28af4c5d passed stages 1-12 incl unit and e2e, then hit the 120 min job limit (1hfdx4); no full green CI run. Siblings: 2 confirmed, both dismissed on review (trackerNodeRuntime default folder is the incident config whose only writer is now guarded; reports atomicJson writes per-run-ID folders). No UI change. Live check after rollout still pending.
